name: R17 M5 Magic Spear Amber Heart

system.description:
Druid exclusive. Increases the amount of HP recovered by "Healing Breeze" and "Healing Wind" you use by +20. When you are in [Regen] status, adds +3D to damage rolls for [Melee Attacks] with this weapon. Item Name: Nazatt's Twin Spear - The Spear of the Forest King Type: One-Handed Spear Class: Weapon Stats: +10 Accuracy, +10 Magic Power, +5 Recovery A legendary spear said to have been used by Nazatt, the Hero of the Ancient Race and King of the Forest. The spear's tip is a crystal infused with the power of nature, sharper than steel. Two decorative cords are attached, with amber embedded at their base. This weapon increases recovery and, when used, emits a pleasant aroma of amber, making it a secret favorite among female druids.

Amber Gem [Core Material] (500G) + Corsesca (730G) + Summoning Gem (Intermediate) (120G) ×3 + [Magic Catalyst 17] (280G) ×4 + Crafting Cost (1090G)
